text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Guuuh, I lost again! Comeback, flat, El's no fan of that—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Or so I say, but this is
no time to be standing around talking, yes!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic of me, desu...
El couldn't spread her wings once again...!
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy for once.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué? What do you mean?
Take it easy in this situation?!

The road to championship is a thorny path.
If you take it on with momentum alone, you'll run out of steam halfway through.
"That's why I said we needed time to carefully consider whether the path we're taking is the right one."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I see. So just giving it your all recklessly won't work, right?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer-san!
I really feel like we can win this rematch!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sì! El is going to ruuun the Victory Road
to the veeery end!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Oui.
I will stand up as many times as it takes, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“The ‘Phantom Bird’ El Condor Pasa
is IMMORTAAAL!!”
choice_data_list: Go blow them away! El Condor Pasa!
Blow them away! El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Claaaaro!!
This time for sure, we are taking on the wooorld, YEEES!!!
